system.description:
Activate Engage (1 AP)

Requirement The rune is ready

Concentric circles spread across the item when activated, forming the impression of a doorway that cannot quite be crossed.

For 1 minute, you emanate a 10-foot spiritual sanctuary. You and willing allies within the aura gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against Fear, possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.

The rune then becomes expended and may be restored using Refocus.

Armour price 11,000 gp; shield price 7,700 gp.

Inscribed onto armour or a shield.

On the sheet: Press Sanctuary on the item (Engage, 1 AP): for 1 minute allies within 10 feet carry the +2 status against Fear, possession, Soul Drain and Soul effects as an aura, and so do you. The rune is then expended; Refocus restores it.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
